tokens.name: surface.frame
tokens.usage: The Frame: Activity rail + Sidebar + Title bar, one L-shaped fill with no seam. Dark value fixed by the owner. Text and icons on it use the text tokens and the frame fill states.

tokens.name: surface.canvas
tokens.usage: The Canvas inset in the Frame (rounded top-left corner, radius.canvas): Conversation, Session summary, Work panel, Project sidebar, Status bar and full-canvas pages. Dark value fixed by the owner; the lightest surface in light.

tokens.name: surface.sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells on the Canvas: text fields, search fields, code blocks, terminal and editor backgrounds. Darker than the Canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: slider.thumb
tokens.usage: Thumb of the reasoning slider in the Model picker (X-AG-02). A light disc in both themes; it sits on the agent brand gradient.

tokens.name: progress.track
tokens.usage: Track of a Progress bar, with border.subtle 1 px. The surface.sunken value; a name of its own so Progress and PlanView share one track token.

tokens.name: surface.raised
tokens.usage: Panels and cards that sit on the Canvas: composer, summary cards, list cards, settings groups. Always paired with border.default.

tokens.name: surface.overlay
tokens.usage: Anything floating above the Canvas: menus, popovers, model picker, tooltips, dialogs, toasts. Always paired with border.default and shadow.e2 or shadow.e3.

tokens.name: text.primary
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on every surface and every fill state. Headings, labels, values.

tokens.name: text.secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text, inactive icons and rail icons, captions, table headers. On every surface and fill state.

tokens.name: text.tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, metadata, line numbers. On every surface and fill state at 4.5:1; never use it for anything the user must act on.

tokens.name: text.disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons. Exempt from the WCAG contrast rule; always paired with a disabled cursor and aria-disabled.

tokens.name: text.on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.default, accent.hover and accent.pressed fills (primary button label, selected checkbox tick).

tokens.name: border.subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: separators inside a panel, list dividers, table rules. Never the only cue that a control exists.

tokens.name: border.default
tokens.usage: Outlines of raised surfaces: cards, composer, popovers, dialogs. Decorative.

tokens.name: border.strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control: text field, checkbox, radio, switch off-track, segmented control, button outline. At least 3:1 on frame, canvas, raised and overlay. Also the splitter hover line.

tokens.name: border.focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring (2 px, offset 2 px). At least 3:1 on frame, canvas, sunken, raised, overlay in its theme. Never hidden by a theme.

tokens.name: border.disabled
tokens.usage: Outline of a disabled control (secondary button, text field, switch track). Decorative and exempt from contrast, always paired with fill.disabled, text.disabled and aria-disabled.

tokens.name: accent.default
tokens.usage: Accent fill: primary button, switch on, selected checkbox/radio, active tab underline, progress. Label on it is text.on-accent. User-chosen accent replaces this set.

tokens.name: accent.hover
tokens.usage: Accent fill on hover. text.on-accent still reads at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent.pressed
tokens.usage: Accent fill while pressed.

tokens.name: accent.fg
tokens.usage: Accent as text, icon, link and active-indicator colour on frame, canvas, raised and overlay (4.5:1). Active rail bar, links, the model picker active bar.

tokens.name: accent.on
tokens.usage: Alias role of text.on-accent for accent surfaces in extension-built views; identical value.

tokens.name: status.success.fg
tokens.usage: Completed, saved, connected, passed. Always with a check icon or the word. Text and icon colour on frame, canvas, raised, overlay and on status.success.bg.

tokens.name: status.success.solid
tokens.usage: Solid success fill (badge, banner icon plate, destructive button for danger). Label on it is status.success.on.

tokens.name: status.success.on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on status.success.solid.

tokens.name: status.success.bg
tokens.usage: Tinted success background, resolved solid on the Canvas (also fine on raised). Text on it is status.success.fg or text.primary.

tokens.name: status.success.border
tokens.usage: Outline of a success banner or chip. Decorative.

tokens.name: status.warning.fg
tokens.usage: Needs attention but not blocked: ahead/behind, slow, expiring. Always with a triangle icon or the word. Text and icon colour on frame, canvas, raised, overlay and on status.warning.bg.

tokens.name: status.warning.solid
tokens.usage: Solid warning fill (badge, banner icon plate, destructive button for danger). Label on it is status.warning.on.

tokens.name: status.warning.on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on status.warning.solid.

tokens.name: status.warning.bg
tokens.usage: Tinted warning background, resolved solid on the Canvas (also fine on raised). Text on it is status.warning.fg or text.primary.

tokens.name: status.warning.border
tokens.usage: Outline of a warning banner or chip. Decorative.

tokens.name: status.danger.fg
tokens.usage: Failed, destructive, irreversible. The solid fill is for destructive buttons only. Always with an octagon or x icon or the word. Text and icon colour on frame, canvas, raised, overlay and on status.danger.bg.

tokens.name: status.danger.solid
tokens.usage: Solid danger fill (badge, banner icon plate, destructive button for danger). Label on it is status.danger.on.

tokens.name: status.danger.on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on status.danger.solid.

tokens.name: status.danger.bg
tokens.usage: Tinted danger background, resolved solid on the Canvas (also fine on raised). Text on it is status.danger.fg or text.primary.

tokens.name: status.danger.border
tokens.usage: Outline of a danger banner or chip. Decorative.

tokens.name: status.danger.hover
tokens.usage: Danger button fill on hover. Dark steps lighter and light steps darker, like accent.hover; status.danger.on stays at least 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: status.danger.pressed
tokens.usage: Danger button fill while pressed. status.danger.on stays at least 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: status.info.fg
tokens.usage: Neutral information and tips. Always with an i icon or the word. Text and icon colour on frame, canvas, raised, overlay and on status.info.bg.

tokens.name: status.info.solid
tokens.usage: Solid info fill (badge, banner icon plate, destructive button for danger). Label on it is status.info.on.

tokens.name: status.info.on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on status.info.solid.

tokens.name: status.info.bg
tokens.usage: Tinted info background, resolved solid on the Canvas (also fine on raised). Text on it is status.info.fg or text.primary.

tokens.name: status.info.border
tokens.usage: Outline of a info banner or chip. Decorative.

tokens.name: agent.running
tokens.usage: Agent status: running. Spinner arc glyph. Shape cue: rotating arc.

tokens.name: agent.waiting
tokens.usage: Agent status: waiting for you (approval or question). Filled circle with a question mark or bell. Needs the user, so it also tints the row with agent.waiting.bg.

tokens.name: agent.idle
tokens.usage: Agent status: idle. Hollow ring. Same value as text.tertiary.

tokens.name: agent.error
tokens.usage: Agent status: error. Triangle with exclamation. Same value as status.danger.fg.

tokens.name: agent.unreachable
tokens.usage: Agent or host unknown or unreachable: the last known state is shown dimmed with its age. Dashed ring with a slash. Never means stopped.

tokens.name: agent.done
tokens.usage: Agent status: finished (check glyph, the sixth agent state). Aliases status.success.fg, so a theme changes both together.

tokens.name: agent.waiting.bg
tokens.usage: Row or card tint for a session waiting on the user, resolved on the Canvas and Frame.

tokens.name: agent.waiting.bg.overlay
tokens.usage: Tint of a Notification card for a session waiting on the user, resolved on surface.overlay. Same offset from the overlay as agent.waiting.bg has from the Canvas.

tokens.name: agent.error.bg
tokens.usage: Row or card tint for a session in error, resolved on the Canvas and Frame.

tokens.name: agent.error.bg.overlay
tokens.usage: Tint of a Notification card for a session in error, resolved on surface.overlay by the same rule.

tokens.name: agent.unreachable.bg
tokens.usage: Tint of an unreachable banner, notification card or Delegation tree row, resolved on the Canvas and overlay. The dashed glyph and dimmed text stay the cue.

tokens.name: agent.unreachable.bg.overlay
tokens.usage: Tint of a Notification card for an unreachable host, resolved on surface.overlay by the same rule.

tokens.name: agent.unreachable.border
tokens.usage: Outline of an unreachable banner or card. Aliases border.default; a theme may give it its own hue.

tokens.name: diff.add.bg

tokens.name: diff.add.gutter

tokens.name: diff.add.word

tokens.name: diff.add.fg

tokens.name: diff.remove.bg

tokens.name: diff.remove.gutter
tokens.usage: Gutter behind line numbers of a removed line, with a minus glyph.

tokens.name: diff.remove.word

tokens.name: diff.remove.fg
tokens.usage: Removed counts (-3), minus glyph and deleted file letter on the Canvas.
